summary: Add USDB network overview and historical Miner Pass queries
details: Add a USDB navigation group to the pinned Blockscout frontend, with separate USDB, explorer and Bitcoin index heights, public wallet metadata, an active Standard pass list and inscription-ID detail queries.

Keep energy values as exact decimal integers and bind pagination, pass profiles and related snapshots to one Bitcoin height and historical system state; distinguish empty results, missing passes, incompatible or unavailable indexers and state changes.

Expose only bounded GET endpoints through the public gateway. Local-node deployments default to the private loopback indexer at port 28020; external deployments require an explicit private indexer_url. Existing full-mode archive and tracing requirements remain in force.

Build the customized frontend from a checksum-verified upstream revision and bind its immutable image digest to packaging, release notes, publication verification and image security scans. Source deployments build the frontend locally; release installations pull the prebuilt image.
Reward, supply, fee-distribution and realtime-push qualification remain unchanged; faucet, minting and signing are outside this change.
operator_actions: After installing a release containing this change, run down, prepare --replace, preflight and up to replace frontend/gateway and apply the private indexer route while retaining credentials and database volumes.

For external RPC deployments, configure rpc.indexer_url with the container-reachable private indexer URL to enable Miner Pass data. For a nondefault local indexer port, use configure --local-node --indexer-url before re-preparing.
Verify the USDB overview and Miner Pass page after startup; an unavailable indexer does not mean there are no passes.
